solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Stumbling below, wearing tacky jewellery

indicators.note: the jewellery has the other piece on it, as clothes are worn, so it goes inside

parts.note: bling is flashy, showy jewellery
below means under

explanation.surface: Someone tottering about beneath, decked out in cheap gaudy jewellery.
explanation.walkthrough: 'below' looks like a position word but supplies a piece; 'wearing' signals the container.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words describe moving clumsily and making mistakes, so they are synonyms.

clue.text: Prepare in Prohibition to be a supplier of booze

indicators.note: the word in tells us one piece is placed within the other

parts.note: a prohibition is a ban
to arm is to prepare, especially for conflict

explanation.surface: Getting ready to serve drink during the American Prohibition era.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Prohibition' looks like the 1920s US era, which fits the booze picture, but here it just means a ban; 'in' signals the container.
explanation.definitionFit: A bartender in a pub serves alcoholic drinks, so he is a supplier of booze.

clue.text: Get out of office as tune is being played

indicators.note: a tune being played is performed in a new way, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A politician is voted out while a song plays.
explanation.walkthrough: 'being played' rearranges the letters of AS TUNE; 'is' only joins.
explanation.definitionFit: To unseat a politician is to remove them from their elected position or post.

clue.text: Girl's part of a dancing set-up? That's a lie

parts.note: Di is a girl's name, short for Diana, with the possessive s
a dancer who is part of a set pattern of dancers is in formation

explanation.surface: Claiming a girl belongs to a dance troupe turns out to be untrue.
explanation.walkthrough: 'That's a' links the wordplay to the definition 'lie'.
explanation.definitionFit: Disinformation is false information spread deliberately, so it amounts to a lie.

clue.text: Tara ruin, I fancy, could be a romantic place

indicators.note: fancy as an adjective means elaborate or made up, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Seeing the ruins of Tara, the Irish royal site, as a romantic spot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fancy' rearranges the letters of TARA RUIN I. Ruritania is the made-up kingdom of Anthony Hope's novel The Prisoner of Zenda.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the fictional kingdom of courtly romance and adventure in Anthony Hope's novels.

clue.text: In a crevice — look there to find valuable material

indicators.note: the answer is to be found by looking within these words of the clue

explanation.surface: Peering into a crack in a rock to find something precious.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters run across 'iN A CREvice'.
explanation.definitionFit: Nacre is mother-of-pearl, a prized lustrous substance from shells used in jewellery and decoration.

clue.text: Old piano introducing American piece of music

parts.note: p is the musical notation for piano, meaning softly
US stands for United States, so American

explanation.surface: An old piano is used to introduce an American composition.
explanation.definitionFit: Opus is the Latin word composers use for a numbered work, so it names a musical composition.

clue.text: Forbearance of a G&S character

definitions.meaning: forbearance is patient self-control and tolerance
the title heroine of Gilbert and Sullivan's comic opera about aesthetes

explanation.definitionFit: The word means calm endurance, and it is also the milkmaid heroine of a Gilbert and Sullivan operetta.

clue.text: Bit of a course to the left?

definitions.text: Bit of a course to the left?

parts.words: Bit of a course to the left?
parts.note: a course is part of a meal, and a portion placed off to one side of the main plate is the picture

explanation.definitionFit: A side dish is a small extra plate of food served alongside a main course, often at the diner's side.

clue.text: A plan hurting me terribly in a tricky political situation

indicators.note: terribly suggests something badly mangled, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A politician complains that a policy is causing them great pain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'terribly' rearranges the letters of A PLAN HURTING ME.
explanation.definitionFit: When no party wins an overall majority of seats, government becomes difficult to form.

clue.text: Rex employs cunning tricks

parts.note: Rex, Latin for king, is abbreviated R as in royal signatures
to employ something is to use it

explanation.surface: A king makes use of crafty schemes.
explanation.definitionFit: Ruses are wily stratagems intended to deceive, the same as cunning tricks.

clue.text: Votes in a tight election may be talked about

definitions.text: Votes in a tight election may be
definitions.meaning: in a close contest the ballots may be counted a second time
narrated or told, as a story is related

explanation.definitionFit: In one sense the word means counted again; in the other it means narrated or told, as a tale.

clue.text: Once more holy person is fighting

parts.note: once more means again
St is the abbreviation for saint, a holy person

explanation.surface: A saint is back in combat again.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is' only joins the wordplay to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Being against something means opposing or battling it, as in fighting against injustice.

clue.text: Humpty Dumpty as an intellectual?

parts.note: the nursery-rhyme figure is an egg, and his top would be a highbrow person by the slang term

explanation.definitionFit: Egghead is slang for a bookish highbrow person, and Humpty Dumpty literally has the head of an egg.

clue.text: Approves of facial expressions

definitions.meaning: to countenance something is to tolerate or sanction it
a countenance is a face or its look

explanation.definitionFit: As a verb the word means tolerates or sanctions; as a plural noun it means faces or their looks.

clue.text: To add detail is complicated

definitions.meaning: to expand on a point by giving more particulars
intricate and involved, as an ornate design

explanation.definitionFit: As a verb the word means expand on a point; as an adjective it means intricate or involved.

clue.text: Expression of faith in William's ability to provide camping item

parts.note: Billy is a pet form of the name William
can expresses being able, having the ability

explanation.surface: Someone declares belief in William's competence to supply gear for a camping trip.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Expression of faith in' sets up the phrase Billy can, a vote of confidence in William.
explanation.definitionFit: A billycan is a metal pot used for boiling water or cooking over a campfire, especially in Australia.

clue.text: Bill with top grade intended going up in scholarly world

parts.note: AC is short for account, a bill
A is the top mark in grading

indicators.note: in a down clue going up means the word is read from bottom to top, backwards

parts.note: intended means aimed, as in aimed to do

explanation.surface: A bill with an A grade meant to be raised, in academic life.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'going up' reads the word for 'intended' from bottom to top; 'with' only joins.
explanation.definitionFit: Academia is the community and environment of universities and scholarship, the learned world.

clue.text: A problem I can work out like no one else?

indicators.note: to work out a problem is to solve it by rearranging, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone boasts that they can solve a puzzle better than anyone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'work out' rearranges the letters of A PROBLEM I CAN.
explanation.definitionFit: Something without equal cannot be compared with anyone else, hence unmatched or peerless.

clue.text: I'd wail horribly in religious festival

indicators.note: horribly suggests something badly wrong, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone says they would cry awfully during a holy celebration.
explanation.walkthrough: 'horribly' rearranges the letters of I'D WAIL.
explanation.definitionFit: Diwali is the Hindu festival of lights celebrated each autumn, so a religious festival.

clue.text: Woman has old lover stuck in a separate building maybe

indicators.note: stuck in says one piece is wedged inside another

parts.note: Anne is a woman's name
an ex is a former partner

explanation.surface: A woman keeps her former partner hidden away in an outbuilding.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stuck in' signals the container; 'has' only joins.
explanation.definitionFit: An annexe is an extra building added to or near a main one, which may stand separately.

clue.text: Short communication about a daughter being horrible girl

indicators.note: about means around, so the shortened word surrounds the other letters
short means cut off, so the last letter is dropped

parts.note: a letter is a written communication
D is the abbreviation for daughter in family trees

explanation.surface: A brief note about a daughter calls her an awful girl.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Short' cuts LETTER to LETTE; 'about' puts A and D inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A ladette is a young woman who behaves loutishly, a rowdy hard-drinking girl in British slang.

clue.text: Uniform delivered on time for special occasion

indicators.note: in a down clue one piece placed on another sits above it, so the time letter comes after

parts.note: uniform means even, regular

explanation.surface: A uniform is delivered punctually for a big occasion.
explanation.definitionFit: An event is something that happens, especially a notable planned occasion.

clue.text: Love helping to put together a speech

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, which looks like O
a helping is a portion or ration of food

explanation.surface: Affection helps in composing a speech.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to put together' only joins wordplay and definition.
explanation.definitionFit: An oration is a formal public address, so it is a speech.

clue.text: Cameron out to gain honour in our time

indicators.note: gaining something means taking it in, so it is placed inside
out suggests being disordered or wrong, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: OM is the Order of Merit, a British honour

explanation.surface: A politician named Cameron is ousted but still collects an award these days.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' rearranges the politician's name, giving CMONERA; 'to gain' signals the container. David Cameron was a British prime minister.
explanation.definitionFit: The Common Era is the secular name for the dating system covering the present age, AD.

clue.text: Avoid temptress conveying commercial message

indicators.note: conveying means carrying, so one piece holds the other

parts.note: Eve tempted Adam in the Bible
an ad is an advertisement

explanation.surface: Steer clear of a seductive woman carrying an advertisement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'temptress' points to the Bible's first woman; 'conveying' signals the container.
explanation.definitionFit: To evade is to escape or dodge something, so it means to avoid.

clue.text: Elegant old cow maybe

definitions.meaning: an archaic word for cattle, of which a cow is an example

explanation.definitionFit: The word means smartly tidy, and is also an old term for bovine animals such as oxen.

clue.text: Is setter, we fancy, wily?

indicators.note: fancy as a verb here suggests imaginatively reworked, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A solver asks whether the crossword compiler is cunning.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fancy' rearranges the letters of IS SETTER WE.
explanation.definitionFit: Streetwise means shrewd and canny in dealing with urban life, so cunning or wily.
